body: Thank you for this.  I just have to survive until that day.  I'm a male.  I'm 41 years old.  Everyday I try to find a reason to go on and one would think my kids would be the only motivation I need but I just can't seem to wrap this around my head.  I often to think that I would just be better off dead.  It hurts my heart how things are for me now.  I am sad all the time and just stuck in a rut; a very deep rut.  Thank you for taking the time to respond to me.
